name: C
description: C11 and CMake, linked to the static or the shared library.
run_windows: cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build --config Release && build\Release\{{PROJECT_IDENT}}.exe
readme:
cmake -S . -B build
    cmake --build build --config Release

then run the program from this folder (`build/{{PROJECT_IDENT}}`, or `build\Release\{{PROJECT_IDENT}}.exe` with Visual Studio). Visual Studio, CLion and VS Code (CMake Tools) open the folder directly.
